title: Layout photos
lede: The HART layout and the room it lives in. Historical photographs, ads, and clippings of the island are on the Photos page under History & Industries.

items.title: Neville Island from above
items.caption: The five-mile strip in the Ohio River — heavy industry, logistics, and a tight community.

items.title: The layout room
items.caption: The whole room: peninsulas on open benchwork, the helix framing, and the river-valley backdrop around the walls.

items.title: West Yard
items.caption: Engine house and coaling tower against the backdrop, with a train on the main behind.

items.title: East Yard
items.caption: Strings of hoppers on bare plywood, track down and scenery still to come.

items.title: South Yard
items.caption: Freight cars filling the yard ladder, ballast down and the backdrop in place.

items.title: Yard tracks by color
items.caption: Colored strips mark which yard track takes cars for which destination.

items.title: Fascia track diagram
items.caption: A framed track diagram with indicator lights at the fascia, below a cut of B&O hoppers.

items.title: Fascia track diagram
items.caption: Indicator lights show switch positions on a yard throat diagram; NS and CSX tags mark the interchange tracks.

items.title: Fascia track diagram
items.caption: Another framed diagram at the fascia, wired from below.

items.title: The scale
items.caption: Scale track with the plant buildings behind it and the scale operating instructions on the deck.

items.title: Scale house and instructions
items.caption: A scale-house mockup next to the HART scale operating instructions.

items.title: Crew sheets
items.caption: Clipboards with crew sheets hung along the fascia, ready for a session.

items.title: The HART binder
items.caption: The red operations binder, with pencils and pens for the paperwork.

items.title: Dispatcher's desk
items.caption: The corner desk where the dispatcher sits, surrounded by the layout.

items.title: Track plan mockup
items.caption: A cut-out model of the track plan on the workbench.

items.title: Planning board
items.caption: Track plan prints, maps, and an aerial photo pinned up for planning.

items.title: Crew lounge
items.caption: Where operators gather before and after a session.

items.title: Railroad reading
items.caption: Railroad history books on the lounge table.
